comment: The cases of the Rust core and of the bindings generated from it, one group per member of packages/rust/interface.json in the case convention of binding G-5: the keys are the parameter names of the member, and a method takes its receiver from the keys of the factory machine.parse (definition, the text of a file of contracts/machines, and reserved, the reserved codes of contracts/fsm.lock.json). The cases with no rule come from contracts/conformance/vectors.json; the cases with the rules FSM-B7-1 to FSM-B7-3 give the kinds that only the core has, and the cases of machine.validate (FSM-B7-4) are the calls of validate that the tests of legacy/packages/compiler/tests/validate-{structure,graph,names}.test.mjs make, with the findings of legacy validate.mjs; their ids name the file and the place of the test (docs/spec/fsm.md, B-7). returns is the result and raises the kind and the category of the error.
